question: Does the factor-pruned operation program causally reproduce the complete rank-8 response circuit?

frozen_program.attention_terms: base-pattern-on-value-change from cue and post-cue sources
frozen_program.exception: include bilinear interaction at MLP1 only on is/was rows
frozen_program.rows: temporal-v11 plus is/was-v10 A1/A2; temporal-v11 P controls

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_factor_reconstruct: authorities and projector hashes replay; complete factor tensors reconstruct coordinates at RSE <=1e-10
predictions.pred_b_factor_pruned_program_is_target_s: for both projectors, factor-pruned worst target residual <=0.15 and signed behavior projection >=0.80 per task
predictions.pred_c_factor_pruned_program_is_selectiv: control margin RMS <=0.10, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02 nat, and top-1 flip fraction <=0.05
